text.text_excerpt: I love Cottage Catering! When I was in medical sales for 3 years, I often depended on them to cater lunches for a crowd. Everything they served was spot on. My favorite things included the vegetable tray, with the yummiest grilled veggies. That was a real crowd pleaser. If I couldn't decide what to serve, they were very helpful. I could just give them a price range, and they always came through with flying colors! The real crowd pleaser was always the white chocolate bread pudding. That is a must for anyone who wants to wow the crowd!!!! If you are lucky enough to live in NOLA, and attend Jazzfest, be sure to stop by for Crawfish Streudel and White Chocolate Bread Pudding. You will think ...

Arguably, the best bread pudding ever! (Besides my grandmothers!) They serve it at Jazz Fest and it is "one of those foods" that I look forward to every year. I just found out that you can order it online...this might be dangerous. Their food is fresh and tasty. Their prices are not too high. A good place to get catering from.

about a year ago my boss asked me to find a caterer for the office parties and I knew the first place to look. We have been ordering from them ever since. We feed around 40 people at a time and everyone says how much they love it. I was not only impressed with the menu selection but the food presentation as well. Everything comes beautifully presented on tray with garnishments. I have made special requests which have all been met in the past. They have great lunch specials that are only $11/person including free delivery and quality paper products. The famous bread pudding is $50 a pan and is worth every penny. You can count on them to make your event effortless.
